DPKGTOOL.description: Package tool to use (e.g., apt-get or aptitude)

APTUPGRADE.description: Method to perform upgrades (upgrade, safe-upgrade, dist-upgrade)

ASSUMEYES.description: Enable --assume-yes flag for apt commands (1 = yes, 0 = no)

GETROOT.description: Command used to elevate privileges (e.g., sudo or su)

CLEANUP.description: Clean package cache after upgrade/install (1 = yes, 0 = no)

UUIDFILE.description: Path to the file storing the host's installation UUID

CLUSTERS.description: Comma-separated list of cluster names for coordinated upgrades (empty = no cluster)
